body.statement: The algorithm \(\mathsf{Alg}\) returns \(h_{\mu}(S)\), every member of \(\mathcal K^*\), and \(S^\star\) exactly. A fixed \(S\) requires a minimum cut on a network with \(2L+2\) vertices and \(L^2+2L\) capacitated arcs. The finite outer step examines at most \((2^L-1)^2\) nonempty pairs and at most \(2^{2L-1}\) effect sets; for \(L=7\), these counts are \(16{,}129\) and \(8{,}192\), respectively.
body.justification: The theorem-level geometry is paired with an auditable exact computation for the motivating support size.
body.gap: DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 gives generic polynomial programs, whereas this proposition exposes the problem-specific min-cut certificate and finite outer search.
body.consumer: It makes the seven-category trial calculation reproducible without optimizing over latent joint tables separately for every candidate certificate.
